implementation_notes: Publish an OpenAPI spec and generate clients with openapi-generator; run Pact contract tests in both repos and enforce the spec with a lint step. Deprecation lives in the spec so generated clients carry it.
idiom_name: generated TypeScript client + Pact contract tests
pitfalls: Hand-written fetch wrappers per consumer, each with its own retry and typing
Spec and generated client drifting because nothing regenerates on CI
